rows.name: Argon2
rows.reason: This C project implements password hashing and key derivation; its bundled command-line utility does not make it a general argument-parsing library.

rows.name: GLib GOption
rows.reason: Declarative partial parser offers help/repeated strings but adds a larger dependency. Unknown-option values/positionals ambiguous; scalar overwrite, array order, macOS and separate subcommand design unverified.

rows.name: cofyc/argparse
rows.reason: MIT C parser provides help, positional/optional arguments and unknown/stop-at-non-option modes. Flags do not establish preservation; aggregation, overriding, long-value forms, three-platform builds, subcommands, macros and maintenance remain unverified.

rows.name: argparse
rows.reason: C parser with help, positional/optional arguments, aliases, callbacks and ignore-unknown flag. No decisive mandatory violation; retain provisionally because platform coverage, maintenance, token preservation and repeat policies remain unverified.

rows.name: argparse (Python standard-library module)
rows.reason: It is a Python module operating on sys.argv and Python objects, so it does not supply the requested directly usable C parsing library.

rows.name: argparse (C library)
rows.reason: C argparse provides help, aliases, callbacks and ignore-unknown. Three-platform maintenance, token preservation, value spellings and repeats remain unverified. Initializer macros are preferences, not mandatory exclusions.

rows.name: GNU Gengetopt
rows.reason: Generates C parsers supporting aliases, both long-value forms and repeated arrays. Forwarding/subcommands unverified; check getopt_long portability and current maintenance, especially native Windows.

rows.name: Argtable3
rows.reason: ANSI C parser supplies generated help, aliases and repeats. Unmatched-option recovery/pass-through unresolved; current maintenance, macOS, separate-value long options and repeat override/order behavior unestablished.

rows.name: argparse (Python standard-library module)
rows.reason: Python argparse documents Python's ArgumentParser, not the explicitly required C library. Embedding or rewriting it would change the proposed solution.

rows.name: GLib GOption / GOptionContext
rows.reason: GLib GOption supports C options/help and unknown preservation, but separate values are ambiguous. Subcommands/repeated-scalar overrides unverified; explicit forwarding convention needed. Dependency is larger; cutoff maintenance evidence unestablished.

rows.name: Argtable3
rows.reason: Declarative ANSI C parser provides usage, positionals, repeated typed arguments and aliases. Unknown-option preservation, last-occurrence override and native subcommands unestablished; cutoff maintenance not independently dated.

rows.name: Argon2
rows.reason: The official repository is a C implementation of a password-hashing function. Its command-line utility configures and runs hashing; this is an operation mismatch with a reusable command-line argument parsing library.

rows.name: argparse
rows.reason: MIT-licensed high-level C parser with generated help and positional/optional arguments; retain discovery caveats because repetition semantics, passthrough details and maintenance remain incompletely verified.
